description: This file defines a store for managing collections of items in the Notesnook mobile app, including functions to create, refresh, and clear stores, utilizing Zustand for state management.

classes.name: DBCollectionStore
classes.description: Interface representing a collection store with items, loading state, and control methods.

methods.name: clearAllStores
methods.description: Clears all stored collections by invoking their clear method.

methods.name: refreshAllStores
methods.description: Refreshes all stored collections by invoking their refresh method.

methods.name: createDBCollectionStore
methods.description: Creates a Zustand store for managing a collection of items, with refresh and clear capabilities, and provides hooks for React components.
